title: AST Node Inventory Generator
description: Map every AST node class to its fields, the grammar rule that emits it, and the evaluator method that executes it.

steps.description: Define NODE_INVENTORY as a list of (NodeClass, fields, grammar_rule, evaluator_method) tuples covering literals, expressions, statements, and the team's NicheNode.
Format and print NODE_INVENTORY as a four-column Markdown table, tagging each row's evaluator method with 'OK' or 'TODO'.

steps.question: What do todo_count and done_count evaluate to for the initial NODE_INVENTORY?
steps.answer: Of the 18 entries in NODE_INVENTORY, 17 name an eval_* method and only NicheNode has 'TODO', so done_count is 17 and todo_count is 1.

steps.description: Compute todo_count and done_count to report the sprint backlog and sprint goals.
Check done_count (17) and todo_count (1) after rendering the inventory table.
